subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should #87711 own the remaining reset-session allocation/header atomicity fix, or should it be split into narrower canonical issues for reset durability, inbound transcript persistence, and Telegram progress recovery?
rationale: The source-visible reset ordering gap is real, but the issue thread mixes multiple adjacent session-state and UX symptoms that have different owners and some already-fixed subcases.

options.title: Split Around Reset Durability
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical reset allocation/header atomicity tracker and move delivery fallback, progress UX, and unrelated compaction/provider subcases to linked narrower issues.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Keep the broad thread open until maintainers can verify every cited phantom-session, compaction, and Telegram delivery symptom together, accepting slower repair routing.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Siblings
options.body: Close this issue only after a maintainer names a stronger open canonical tracker that explicitly covers the remaining reset ordering gap.

recommendation.title: Split Around Reset Durability
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical reset allocation/header atomicity tracker and move delivery fallback, progress UX, and unrelated compaction/provider subcases to linked narrower issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The central remaining source evidence is in session lifecycle/reset paths currently routed through commits attributed to Peter Steinberger, though the introducer trail is ambiguous.
